shortDescription: Module to manage host networks in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: check
options.description: If I(true) verify connectivity between host and engine. Network configuration changes will be rolled back if connectivity between engine and the host is lost after changing network configuration.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: interface
options.description: Name of the network interface where logical network should be attached.

options.name: labels
options.description: List of names of the network label to be assigned to bond or interface.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the host to manage networks for.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: networks
options.description: List of dictionary describing networks to be attached to interface or bond:

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: save
options.description: If I(true) network configuration will be persistent, otherwise it is temporary. Default I(true) since Ansible 2.8.

options.name: sync_networks
options.description: If I(true) all networks will be synchronized before modification

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
